quote: This paper reviews all available information on hypoxia-induced changes in the expression of all CXC chemokines (CXCL1, CXCL2, CXCL3, CXCL4, CXCL5, CXCL6, CXCL7, CXCL8 (IL-8), CXCL9, CXCL10, CXCL11, CXCL12 (SDF-1), CXCL13, CXCL14, CXCL15, CXCL16, CXCL17) as well as CXC chemokine receptors-CXCR1, CXCR2, CXCR3, CXCR4, CXCR5, CXCR6, CXCR7 and CXCR8.
summary: Review of hypoxia effects on CXC chemokines in cancer that lists CXCL11 among all CXC chemokines, with no UC content.

quote: Consistent with skin expression, AD serum showed up-regulation of Th2 (IL-13, CCL17, eotaxin-1/CCL11, CCL13, CCL4, IL-10), Th1 (CXCL10, CXCL11) and Th1/Th17/Th22 (IL-12/IL-23p40) responses.
summary: Serum CXCL11 is among Th1 proteins raised in atopic dermatitis versus controls in a proteomic panel; no UC data.

quote: Treatment of ECs with PPARgamma activators significantly inhibited IFN-gamma-induced mRNA and protein expression of the CXC chemokines IFN-inducible protein of 10 kDa (IP-10), monokine induced by IFN-gamma (Mig), and IFN-inducible T-cell alpha-chemoattractant (I-TAC), whereas expression of the CC chemokine monocyte chemoattractant protein-1 was not altered.
summary: PPARgamma activators reduced IFN-gamma-induced I-TAC (CXCL11) expression in human endothelial cells; CXCL11 was a readout, not perturbed, and no colitis was studied.

quote: Patients who developed irAEs had lower levels of CXCL9, CXCL10, CXCL11 and CXCL19 at baseline and exhibited greater increases in CXCL9 and CXCL10 levels at post treatment compared to patients without irAEs.
summary: Lower baseline serum CXCL11 was seen in cancer patients who later developed immune-related adverse events on checkpoint inhibitors; not a UC study.

quote: The chemokine receptor, CXCR3, and its ligands, CXCL9, CXCL10, and CXCL11 are key immune chemoattractants during interferon-induced inflammatory responses.
summary: Review of CXCR3 and its ligands including CXCL11 in skin inflammation and skin cancer; no UC content.

quote: In this study, we first demonstrate that in COS-7 cells heterologously expressing CXCR3, CXCL11 is a potent activator of the pertussis toxin (PTX)-sensitive p44/p42 mitogen-activated protein kinase (MAPK) and Akt/phosphatidylinositol 3 kinase (PI3K) pathways.
summary: CXCL11 activates MAPK and Akt signaling via CXCR3 in cells and T cells; chemotaxis toward CXCR3 ligands depends on phospholipase C rather than these pathways. No colitis outcome.

quote: Suppression of type I IFN release by HDAC3/6i resulted in reduced expression of a subset of IFN-dependent genes, including the chemokines CXCL9 and CXCL11.
summary: CXCL11 expression fell when HDAC3 was inhibited in rheumatoid arthritis synoviocytes, as one of several IFN-dependent genes; CXCL11 itself was not perturbed.

quote: After IFN-γ treatment, 7 genes were upregulated in WJ-MSC, including chemokine ligands CXCL9, CXCL10 and CXCL11, and the adhesion protein VCAM1and ICAM1.
summary: CXCL11 is among genes induced by IFN-gamma in Wharton's jelly mesenchymal stem cells; a stem cell comparison study with no UC data.

quote: IL-17 strongly repressed TNF-alpha-stimulated expression of CXCL10, CXCL11, and CCL5, but synergized with TNF-alpha for induction of CXCL8, CXCL1, and CCL20 mRNAs.
summary: IL-17 repressed TNF-stimulated CXCL11 mRNA in HT-29 colonic epithelial cells, unlike neutrophil-recruiting chemokines; CXCL11 itself was not perturbed.

quote: Six proteins (MMP10, CXCL9, CCL11, SLAMF1, CXCL11 and MCP-1) were up-regulated
summary: Plasma CXCL11 was among six proteins raised years before ulcerative colitis diagnosis and part of a panel highly predictive of later UC.

quote: CXCR3 and its ligands, CXCL9, CXCL10, and CXCL11, are closely associated with the development and progression of many tumors.
summary: Review of CXCR3 and its ligands including CXCL11 in tumour development; no UC content.

quote: These chemokines consist of CCL3 (macrophage inflammatory protein-1 alpha; MIP-1 alpha), CCL4 (MIP-1 beta), CCL5 (regulated on activation normal T cell expressed and secreted; RANTES), CXCL10 (interferon-gamma-inducible protein-10; IP-10), CXCL11 (interferon-inducible T-cell alpha chemoattractant; I-TAC), and CXCL9 (monokine induced by interferon gamma; Mig) and they recruit T cells expressing either CCR5 or CXCR3 chemokine receptors.
summary: Review of chemokines in hepatitis C where CXCL11 is one of the Th1-associated chemokines recruiting T cells to the liver; no UC content.

quote: In fact, CXCR3 and the ligands for this chemokine receptor, monokine-induced by interferon-gamma (IFN-gamma) (MIG/CXCL9), IFN-gamma-inducible 10 kDa protein (IP-10/CXCL10), and IFN-gamma-inducible T cell alpha-chemoattractant (I-TAC/CXCL11) are differentially expressed at sites of colitis in IL-10(-/-) mice and in clinical cases of CD.
summary: Review stating CXCL11 and other CXCR3 ligands are differentially expressed in murine colitis and Crohn's disease, with therapeutic focus on CXCL10 and CXCR3 blockade.

quote: Due to biased signaling CXCR3 also couples to anti-inflammatory signaling and immunosuppressive regulatory T cell formation when activated by CXCL11.
summary: Review of the CXCL10/CXCR3 axis in cardiac inflammation noting CXCL11 biases CXCR3 toward anti-inflammatory Treg formation; no UC content.

quote: In the human intervention, prebiotic supplementation did not drive any global changes in alpha- or beta-diversity, but the abundance of certain bacterial taxa, particularly Ruminococcaceae (Clostridium cluster IV), Parabacteroides, Phascolarctobacterium, increased, and levels of the chemokine CXCL11 were significantly lower in the frail elderly group, but increased during the wash-out period.
summary: Serum CXCL11 was lower in frail elderly people and rose during wash-out in a prebiotic trial; no UC data.

quote: The CXC-chemokines, growth-related oncogene (GRO)-alpha/CXCL1 and interleukin (IL)-8/CXCL8, both recruit neutrophils and possess mitogenic properties, whereas the interferon-dependent CXC-chemokines monokine induced by gamma-interferon (MIG)/CXCL9, interferon-gamma inducible protein of 10 kD/CXCL10, and IFN-inducible T cell alpha chemoattractant/CXCL11 recruit and activate T cells and NK cells.
summary: UC study measuring GRO-alpha and MIG; CXCL11 is named only in the background and was not measured.
